query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM (
                                   SELECT FROM svs.runs r
                                   WHERE svs.run_matches(r, $1)
                                     AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL
                                          OR (r.updated_at >= $2
                                              AND r.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $3)))
                                   LIMIT $4) x
